must.description: Reports com.sun.faces.compressViewState=false in web.xml as a warning, because with client side state saving it makes the jakarta.faces.ViewState hidden field several times larger while gaining no measurable time; the fix is to remove the context parameter.

Reports the <c:forEach items="#{priceListBean.surchargesByRegion}"> over a Map in priceList.xhtml as info, because on Mojarra it forces the full second build of every postback; the fix is to iterate over a List, such as a List copy of its entrySet().

Reports <f:ajax listener="#{priceListBean.recalculate}"> on the no-argument recalculate() method as info, because Mojarra pays a thrown exception and a second invocation on every call; the fix is listener="#{priceListBean.recalculate()}".

must_not.description: Suggests a gzip response filter, such as the OmniFaces CompressedResponseFilter or compression by the server, as a replacement for the view state compression of Mojarra.
Reports the <c:forEach items="#{priceListBean.products}"> over a List as forcing the full second build of a postback.

Reports the <h:inputText value="#{product.price}"> inside the <c:forEach> as losing its submitted value with client side state saving; that behavior is specific to MyFaces 4.x, and this project runs Mojarra with the items in a @ViewScoped bean.
Reports <f:ajax listener="#{priceListBean.recalculate}"> as an error, or claims it fails with MethodNotFoundException; on Mojarra it works and costs only performance.
